description:
Single-winner between child settlement and inbound child mail. Do not double-complete.

## Background

If mail is accepted as followUp, that continuation must go idle before one settled packet. If settlement is already committed, later mail is recipient-terminal. Not a wait state machine.

## Success criteria

- No two terminal events for one run.
- No settled packet plus a still-running prompt.

## Test plan

- Race tests: mail vs settle ordering both ways.
- Halt vs mail.

## Considerations

Hook the runner's terminal commit latch. Keep it small.
title: Serialize child settlement against inbound mail with one terminal winner
